# Supplementary Figure 9 — T1214 / PqqU (CASP15 TonB-dependent transporter)

Apo vs bound states of CASP target T1214: **T1214v2** (apo) vs **T1214v1** (bound), scored
by Cα-RMSD to each reference (x = `bound_rmsd`, y = `apo_rmsd`).

**Method (divide-and-conquer → occurrence voting).** Clade-based divide-and-conquer spreads
the MSA; occurrence voting enriches each state; the top-16 sequences per state are
re-predicted (5 models × 8 seeds = 40 structures), against a 16-random control.

**Figure** = `four_panel_apo_bound_rmsd.png`, generated by
`results_updated/T1214/run2/random_16/plot_four_panel_rmsd.py`. Sources copied (read-only)
from `results_updated/T1214/run2/`.

| Panel | Backing CSV (this folder) | Source | Rows |
|-------|---------------------------|--------|------|
| Divide & Conquer | `panel1_divide_and_conquer_structure_analysis.csv` | `divide_and_conquer/structure_analysis_results.csv` | 2,210 |
| Apo top-16 | `panel2_apo_top16.csv` | `occurrence_voting_apo/results_top_16/top_pred/structure_analysis_results.csv` | 40 |
| Bound top-16 | `panel3_bound_top16.csv` | `occurrence_voting_bound/results_top-16/top_pred/structure_analysis_results.csv` | 40 |
| Random-16 control | `panel4_random16_control.csv` | `random_16/random16_pred/structure_analysis_results.csv` | 40 |

References: `T1214v2.pdb` (apo), `T1214v1.pdb` (bound).
